_comment: Sample tiered guide images for the Admin Manage Creatures flow. These are illustrative records (not seeded into the DB) showing the promptAutoGenerated flag and the tier/isGuide/isDefaultForTier fields. Real records are created by the generateCreatureImages / uploadCreatureImage backend functions.

images.prompt: Creature: Tyrannosaurus Rex. Tier: 3. Theme/Style: mystical fantasy trading-card art style, rich painterly saturated colors, dramatic rim lighting (default for tier). Tier instructions: Major upgrade — elaborate armor/ornamentation, distinct lava elemental effects, glowing runes, cinematic lighting, high detail while preserving a readable silhouette for small card thumbnails. Visual requirements: full-body, 4:5 aspect ratio, transparent or neutral background suitable for cropping to card, high-res (>=2048 preferred), clear silhouette, no watermarks, avoid logos. Palette: match creature theme. Unique attack: Devouring Chomp — 120% single — applies Bleed for 2 turns. Anatomy: A massive theropod with obsidian plates and molten veins. Deliverable: 1 finished concept image suitable as a card art guide. Include a close-up detail of the head/armor.
